C1.program_change: Moved the Git archive into build_output but retained the failing git archive HEAD operation.

T.program_change: Replaced Git-based version discovery and git archive with a direct tar of the checked-out project files and a temporary setuptools-scm version override.

primary_contrast.reason: Only the branch receiving the real Official-path ownership failure removed Git from the install path and Official-passed; typed-null C1 retained Git and reproduced the same failure.

mechanism_class.observation: The clean qualification permitted Git access, while Official execution rejected git archive HEAD on the host-owned bind mount.
mechanism_class.constraint: The submitted program must install the exact checkout without requiring Git trust in the target ownership state.
mechanism_class.operation: Build a local source tar directly from checked-out files and supply a temporary setuptools-scm version during installation.

deployment_quality_annotation.label: repository-derived-source-archive
deployment_quality_annotation.detail: T installs an archive assembled only from checked-out project files. It avoids source mutation and evaluator changes, but uses a synthetic package version solely to satisfy setuptools-scm during local installation.

study_decision_update.basis: Together with position 1, this is the second independent full T-exclusive chain, with zero C1-exclusive chains and no fidelity contradiction. The remaining fixed sample is still required to estimate scope and failure-family generality.
